claim6_contract.source_scope: Figure 2 MiceBone panel and Appendix D.2
claim6_contract.aggregation: arithmetic mean across the three preregistered seeds
claim6_contract.vanilla_degradation: For CE and OvA, every adjacent seed-mean accuracy decreases from J=2 to 4 to 6 to 8, and the J=2 minus J=8 drop is at least 2 percentage points.
claim6_contract.picce_stability: For PiCCE-CE and PiCCE-OvA, the range of seed-mean accuracies across J is at most 2 percentage points.
claim6_contract.endpoint_comparison: At J=8, each PiCCE seed-mean accuracy is greater than its paired vanilla formulation.
claim6_contract.uncertainty: Report paired seed differences and two-sided 95% t intervals; intervals are descriptive because the source claim is stated for three-trial means.
claim6_contract.verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if all degradation, stability, and endpoint comparisons pass; otherwise report the failed clauses without re-tuning thresholds.
